Overview of Canton of Lucerne Region (Luzern)

Canton of Lucerne Region (Luzern) is located in the Canton of Lucerne region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Lucerne. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) & Old Town, Lake Lucerne paddle steamers, Mount Pilatus & Mount Rigi excursions, Swiss Museum of Transport (Verkehrshaus).

RegionCanton of Lucerne
Capital cityLucerne
Cities & municipalities30
Primary transport hubLucerne Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Canton of Lucerne Region

1 hour by direct SBB InterRegio train from Zurich; GoldenPass Express terminus and Lake Lucerne steamships. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canton of Lucerne

When visiting cities across Canton of Lucerne, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Luzerner Chügelipastete
  • Alpine cheese fondue
  • Birnenweggen pear pastry
  • Local cider & lake fish

Best time to visit Canton of Lucerne

Best time to visit Canton of Lucerne: May–Oct.
